protocol.sender_order: associated transaction count DESC, address ASC; separately per original window
protocol.exclude_population: all transactions from the selected positive senders
protocol.macro_recall: unweighted mean of sender recalls across all active positive senders, including zero recoveries
protocol.threshold: original frozen q995, unchanged after sender exclusions
protocol.baseline_scope: original population; no fitted parameters or label-based direction selection
protocol.reference: existing normalized historical sender association, grouped with bool_or
protocol.type_scope: counts, prevalence and AE/IF q995 flags; no AP per type or changed representation
